会改变整个方案的形状,周边设计随之变化
面试要求现场手写它们的实现
它们在任何场景下都比哈希表快
options_en: They can completely replace a general-purpose database.
They change the shape of the whole solution, and surrounding designs shift with it.
Interviews require you to implement them from scratch on a whiteboard.
They are always faster than a hash table in every scenario.
why: 当简单加机器不够用时,专用数据结构不只是局部提速,而是改变方案的“形状”——周边系统会因此设计得完全不同,理解这点能设计出更高效、可扩展的系统。
why_en: Specialized data structures matter because they change the shape of the whole solution, making the surrounding system fundamentally different rather than just faster.
optionExplanations: 数据库负责持久化和查询,布隆过滤器不做存储,替代不了数据库
正确:选用后,周边组件(缓存/存储/校验层)的设计方式都会跟着变
面试通常只要求知道何时用、如何权衡,很少要求手写位运算实现
布隆过滤器牺牲精确性换内存,查询开销不一定比哈希表低
optionExplanations_en: A database handles persistence and querying; a Bloom filter stores nothing, so it cannot replace one.
Correct: once adopted, the design of surrounding components like caching and validation changes with it.
Interviews usually test when and why to use these structures, rarely a whiteboard bit-manipulation implementation.
A Bloom filter trades exactness for memory, so it is not universally faster than a hash table.

q: 布隆过滤器在抽象上最接近哪种数据结构的概率版?
q_en: Conceptually, a Bloom filter is a probabilistic version of which data structure?
options: 队列(插入和弹出)
图(节点和边)
有序列表(排序遍历)
集合(插入元素、查询成员是否存在)
options_en: A queue (push and pop).
A graph (nodes and edges).
A sorted list (ordered traversal).
A set (insert elements, check membership).
why: 布隆过滤器是集合(set)的概率类比:支持插入和成员查询,但用概率答案换取远小于哈希表的内存。
why_en: A bloom filter is a probabilistic analog of a set, supporting inserts and membership checks with far less memory than a hash table.
optionExplanations: 队列关心顺序进出,不支持“是否存在”这种成员查询语义
图建模的是节点间的关系,不是元素的成员关系
有序列表关心顺序遍历,不是概率化的成员测试
正确:集合语义(插入+成员查询)正是布隆过滤器概率化的对象
optionExplanations_en: A queue is about ordered push/pop, not an is-it-present query.
A graph models relationships between nodes, not set membership.
An ordered list is about traversal order, not probabilistic membership testing.
Correct: set semantics — insert plus membership check — is exactly what a Bloom filter makes probabilistic.

A hash table's insert is O(n).

why_en: A hash table gives O(1) inserts and lookups but needs memory for every element, which becomes infeasible at trillions of items.
optionExplanations: 正确:哈希表按元素数线性占内存,万亿级时不可行
哈希表插入是均摊 O(1),不是 O(n)
哈希表恰恰支持成员查询,这不是它的短板
哈希表可以完全放在内存里,不要求必须落盘

Membership queries are exactly what a hash table supports well; that is not its weakness.
A hash table can live entirely in memory; it is not required to be on disk.

q: 布隆过滤器能可靠给出哪些回答?(多选)
q_en: Which answers can a Bloom filter give reliably? (multi-select)
options: 元素“可能”在集合中(概率可配置)
元素“一定不”在集合中
元素“一定”在集合中
元素出现了多少次
options_en: The element is probably in the set (configurable probability).
The element is definitely not in the set.
The element is definitely in the set.
How many times the element occurred.
why: 布隆过滤器只有两种回答:可能在(有可配置的假阳性率)和一定不在。它永远无法证明元素一定在,也不提供计数。
why_en: A bloom filter can only say an element is probably in the set or definitely not in it, never that it is certainly present.
optionExplanations: 正确:能给出配置好的假阳性率下的“可能在”
正确:位缺失时的“一定不在”是绝对可靠的结论
布隆过滤器永远无法证明“一定在”,这正是它的代价
结构里没有计数信息,回答不了出现次数

Correct: a missing bit gives an absolutely reliable definitely-not-present answer.
A Bloom filter can never prove definite presence; that certainty is exactly what it gives up.
The structure carries no count information, so it cannot answer how many times.

q: 补全布隆过滤器的读写机制:
q_en: Fill in the Bloom filter read/write mechanism:
text: 插入元素时,用 {{k}} 个不同的哈希函数各哈希一次,把对应比特位都置为 {{1}}(相当于按位 OR 盖章);查询时若任意一位是 {{0}},该元素一定不在集合中。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种概率型集合结构,用位数组和多个哈希函数判断元素是否可能存在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic set structure that uses a bit array and multiple hash functions to test whether an element is possibly present.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用二维计数器数组估计元素出现次数上界的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Count-Min Sketch is a probabilistic structure that uses a two-dimensional counter array to estimate an upper bound on how often an item appeared.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用极小内存估计数据集中不重复元素个数(基数)的概率结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HyperLogLog is a probabilistic structure that estimates the number of distinct elements, or cardinality, in a dataset using very little memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把值域切成若干区间(桶),只记录每个区间的计数,用有界内存近似分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram divides the value range into buckets and tracks only per-bucket counts, approximating the distribution in bounded memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量数据分布中某个百分比位置的值,如 P95 表示 95% 的数据小于等于它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A percentile marks the value below which a given percentage of the data falls, so P95 means ninety-five percent of values are at or below it.
